claim: report_render.py hard-fails render when a ledger HMAC sidecar exists but signature verification fails
sub_question: When does report_render.py render hard-fail on ledger signature state?
evidence: After schema validation, if evidence-ledger.csv.hmac exists and _verify_signature returns false, render prints a hard-fail message and returns 1.
quote_or_anchor: error: ledger signature verification FAILED — refusing to render
notes: Primary hard-fail on signature state during normal render path; unsigned ledgers only warn.

claim: With --require-signature, render hard-fails before other report inputs when verification fails or ledger/sidecar is missing
sub_question: When does report_render.py render hard-fail on ledger signature state?
evidence: --require-signature runs preflight first: missing ledger, missing .hmac sidecar, or failed _verify_signature each cause cmd_render to return 1.
quote_or_anchor: error: ledger signature verification FAILED - refusing to render
notes: Preflight also rejects missing evidence-ledger.csv and missing sidecar under --require-signature.

claim: _verify_signature returns False when D_RESEARCH_LEDGER_KEY is unset while a sidecar exists
sub_question: When does report_render.py render hard-fail on ledger signature state?
